title: 为什么爱越来越难？
titleEnglish: Why Is Love Becoming More Difficult?
introChinese: 这一次，不去统计表白、鲜花和消费数据，而是以 Sixth Tone 多年来的报道为起点，从爱情、婚姻与身体三个维度，重新理解当代中国的亲密关系。

introParagraphsChinese.text: 这一次，不去统计表白、鲜花和消费数据，而是以 Sixth Tone 多年来的报道为起点，从爱情、婚姻与身体三个维度，重新理解当代中国的亲密关系。
introParagraphsChinese.text_en: Rather than counting declarations of love, flowers, or holiday spending, this edition begins with years of Sixth Tone reporting, exploring contemporary intimacy through three dimensions: love, marriage, and the body.

introParagraphsChinese.text: 这些报道看似讨论的是不同的社会事件，却不断指向同一个问题：
introParagraphsChinese.text_en: These reports may appear to concern separate social events, yet they repeatedly point toward the same question:
Why is love becoming more difficult?

introParagraphsChinese.text: 当婚姻与经济压力、照护劳动、职业发展、生育期待和关系中的安全风险交织在一起，年轻人面对的不再只是“要不要结婚”，而是“怎样的关系才值得进入”。
introParagraphsChinese.text_en: When marriage becomes entangled with economic pressure, care work, career development, reproductive expectations, and safety risks within relationships, young people are no longer asking only whether to marry, but what kind of relationship is worth entering.

introParagraphsChinese.text: 这期的特别报道试图沿着这些新闻留下的线索，重新理解当代中国年轻人的亲密关系，也重新思考一个或许没有标准答案的问题：
introParagraphsChinese.text_en: Following the trails left by these stories, this special report seeks to reconsider intimate relationships among young people in contemporary China—and a question that may have no definitive answer:

introParagraphsChinese.text: 爱的困难，究竟来自人与人之间，还是来自我们所生活的社会？
introParagraphsChinese.text_en: Does the difficulty of love ultimately arise between people, or from the society in which we live?

sections.heading: Research Question｜研究问题
sections.summaryChinese: 年轻人正在失去爱的能力，还是正在把爱情与婚姻制度区分开来？

sections.heading: Research｜研究
sections.summaryChinese: 综合新闻报道、学术研究、公共数据与公共卫生证据，理解爱情、婚姻与身体如何共同塑造现代亲密关系。
